description: An answer whose every claim is supported by a source the system provided in this request.
A reference from a claim to a provided source, such as `[2]`, mapped back to a document id and location for the reader.
Checking in code that a reply cites at least one source and that every cited source was actually provided, instead of trusting the prompt.
The minimum retrieval score for a passage to enter the context. When nothing passes, the system refuses without calling the model.
One extra model call with the rejected reply and specific feedback. Bounded so a stubborn model cannot run up cost.
Whether the cited sources actually support the answer's claims. Measured offline with judges or entailment models (module 10).
